workflowId.description: The registered workflowId, now resolvable by POST /v1/runs and the builder.

preservedFields.description: ADR 0524 §5 — fields the submitted definition omitted ENTIRELY that the host KEPT from the existing workflow rather than deleting (this pack's response schema cannot express them, so an omission is not a deletion). Absent when the save was lossless. To genuinely delete one, name it in the persist tool's `clearFields`.
